entry.summary: This release includes critical security fixes for the Apigee Operator for Kubernetes. We have upgraded several core components, including Netty, Jackson, Jetty, Vert.x, and Guava, to address various vulnerabilities. Please update to the latest version to ensure your environment is protected.
